verdict.rationale: The jobs-v2 create endpoint documents submitting a URL to a publicly accessible audio file as the standard ingestion method. A custom user-agent option for the fetch and an option to redact the input_url confirm the service retrieves the recording itself, with no upload needed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of signed/pre-signed URL support (e.g., expiry or auth-header handling), independent or hands-on corroboration of URL-based ingestion.
